The task succeeded after the child used the screwdriver properly to assemble the frame and attach the shelves.

Initially unsure whether to use the spoon or measuring cup for transfer, the child was guided to fill the measuring cup directly from the sugar bowl and level it off with the knife for accuracy. The task succeeded after the caregiver emphasized using the correct tool and technique for measuring dry ingredients.
